verdict.rationale: Snowflake CLI (`snow sql`) runs fully headless (verified via runtime probe: pipes SQL from stdin, inline queries, no dashboard), and the CLI is officially documented as keyless-installable with credential-based auth at execution time. Governance is native via RBAC (roles/privileges) and access-history logging, and the Snowflake-managed MCP server lets agents query Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents and run raw SQL as tools without extra infrastructure. Missing for 10: no explicit documented example of schema discovery (e.g., `snow sql -q "SHOW SCHEMAS"`) as a first-class agent workflow, and no independent/hands-on report of an agent doing the full auth→discover→query→read loop end-to-end.
